name: Wolfpack Wednesday NC II 2026
information: **This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event and takes place on a Wednesday evening.** **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCII2026#76282-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCII2026#76288-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4MTYxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--af0585c8fc7c8df1b310e5683b32896ba39aa835/image.png)
